name: Beaver Fleming

summary: Beaver Fleming is a pro skateboarder, author and official Nitro Circus touring cast member who started in Knoxville, Tennessee, and has competed and won at the highest level of skateboarding around the world. He has created multiple world-first tricks, including the Cork 720 Christ Air, won Best Trick at Simple Session three times and competed in X Games Big Air. He speaks often at schools and youth groups with a message of determination and perseverance, sharing the practical tools that let him succeed in a not-so-common career path.

talks: Livin' the Dream: determination, perseverance and the practical tools behind a not-so-common career path. Keynote or school assembly.
Prepare for the Opportunity: “If you prepare yourself for opportunities, opportunities will present themselves to you.” Keynote.
Performance Under Pressure: staying focused when the stakes, and the ramp, are at their highest. Keynote.
Calculated Risk: how a pro decides what to attempt and how to prepare for it. Keynote.
Dream Big: from a backyard halfpipe in Tennessee to Nitro Circus. Keynote or school assembly.
